notes.title: Stolen Realm Kickstarter Launch!
notes.content:
We've Launched Our New Game On Kickstarter!

We need your help to fund and make this game all it can be! This game simply won't be as good without your support.

BACK US ON KICKSTARTER TODAY!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31726344/80b0c1c29ca41163ff71beebbe29476e49129365.png

What Sets Us Apart

We are huge fans of turn based co-op RPGs (we constantly play games like Divinity or Baldur’s Gate 3 etc.) but found that there were some common drawbacks.
[olist]
 Turns take too long (especially when you have that one friend on your team that has to calculate every possible combination of outcomes before taking his turn).
 Targeting/Navigation is sometimes tedious.
 Excessive waiting for other players to finish activities you're not involved in.
 Storyline difficult to follow in multiplayer mode.
[/olist]

With Stolen Realm we are trying to solve these issues by implementing the following:
[olist]
 A simultaneous team turn system for faster paced combat.
 Fixed camera with a hex based grid for easy navigation and targeting.
 Fun, rewarding activities and exploration where all members of the party always have something to do.
 An engaging story that brings you along as a party.
 [Bonus] The ragdoll effects make pummeling enemies feel incredible!
[/olist]


We can't wait to hear what you think. We are so thankful for all your support!

BACK US ON KICKSTARTER TODAY!

notes.title: Armored Evolution Full Release - Feb 1
notes.content:
We're extremely happy to announce that Armored Evolution leaves early access into full release today!  It's been an awesome journey with great help from our community.

Highlights

 Eight breathtaking worlds from the foggy depths of Pythus to the fiery pits of Magrus
 Three challenging difficulties including hardcore mode for the truly fearless
 Endless mode which mixes and matches your favorite worlds and enemies for infinite destruction
 Thousands of viable builds, mixing and matching powerful armored vehicles and awesome weapons
 Incredibly unique enemies
 Hundreds of hours of content
 Engaging 4 player co-op


Please join us on our epic quest through the universe!




2.0.0 Release Notes

Content

 Able to now send items to teammates


Fixes

 Fixed connectivity issues when playing co-op
 Fixed issues dealing with hardcore deaths not properly deleting profiles
 Added compatibility check when joining a game to ensure correct game mode
 Fixed AI navigation issues (including spawning in walls in Magrus)
 Fixed various issues with physics collisions
 Fixed issue with checkpoints in endless mode causing a bug where you wouldn't receive loot on death
 Completely re-balanced endless mode
 Endless mode is now compatible with multiplayer
 Made some bosses harder to beat
 Fixed various GUI bugs

notes.title: Major Patch: 1.0.4 Difficulty Levels, Endless Mode, Item Mods and New World
notes.content:
Get ready for our biggest patch yet!  Experience the frozen world of Zespain with brand new enemies that fly and reflect damage.  Once you're finished with that there's endless amounts of content with our new Endless mode.  How far can you get as a mix of deadly enemies of increasing difficulty try to destroy you?  Items can now roll modifiers to allow better upgrades and sweeter combinations.  Think you're untouchable?  Try out the new hardcore mode which deletes your play through if you ever fail.  This along with 2 new difficulties will have you coming back for more time and time again.  Read about these and many more improvements and bug fixes below!

Major Features


  New world Zespain with all new enemies
  Endless Mode mixing maps and enemies across all worlds with infinite difficulties
  Easy, Normal and Hard Difficulties
  Multiple profile saves to allow multiple playthroughs at once
  Hardcore mode
  Items now roll health and damage modifiers for increased destructive power


Features


  New Tech Core "Stasis Beam"
  Music added for worlds 4 to 7
  Flying Enemies
  Additional Steam Achievements
  Improved Enemy Skills and Balancing
  Sound Effect Improvements
  Steam Cloud Saves


Fixes


  Improved networking performance
  Fixed issue with client pause menu
  Fixed client turret animation
  Fixed various physics collision issues


Misc


  Laser is now found on the basic/unique/legendary tiers

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3: New World, Legendary Avatars & Weapons, Achievements
notes.content:
Get ready for the dangerous lava world Magrus with frightening new enemies who can pull you into hazardous terrain!  Luckily you'll have all new legendary weapons and avatars to deal with them.  You'll be able to show off your prowess on each level with shiny new Steam Achievements.

We've included many other improvements and bug fixes which you can find detailed below.

Content

new world magrus added
added functionality for hazardous terrain
added in game pickups
access to legendary cores and avatars
added steam achievements
wave progression is now much faster
improved models and textures for some player and ai avatars
improved overall balancing
various sound effect improvements


Interface

revamped menu layouts
more visable healthbars with team colors
items can now be sold at the store
you now can quick sell items on the loot screen
store now shows if you already own an item
store, core selector and avatar selector menus now use a scrolling system rather than a page system
updated skillbar which now includes a health and ultimate bar
added a popup message when new items are available in the store


Fixes

fixed issues with mesh effects from fury, sludge etc
fixed issue where aegis wasn't working properly with Cannon
fixed animation speed on walkers
fixed issue where healthbars would be obstructed by objects
fixed issue with faulty enhancement costs
fixed issue with cluster nova causing lag


Misc

you can now chain infinite kill streak bonuses
changed laser size enhancement to laser length
cannon now has quicker reload speeds
laser can no longer be blocked by projectiles

notes.title: Release 1.02: Bugfixes
notes.content:
After releasing version 1.0.1 yesterday the community began to post bugs that they encountered that caused missing weapons and menu problems.  We are very sorry those bugs went out uncaught.  However, we are happy to announce that we believe we have solved these issues with release 1.0.2.  We owe a big thanks to the community for posting these issues!

Fixes


   Fixed a bug causing weapon selection to appear empty despite having weapons
   Fixed a bug causing slots to show in incorrect places
   Fixed visual ground clipping on Chandra 1

notes.title: 1.0.1 Release: New World, New Enemies, New Items, PvP and Steam Connect
notes.content:
We're excited to release version 1.0.1 of our game for PC and Mac!  It contains a whole new world with more maps, more enemies, more items and brand new mechanics.  You can now play directly against your friends in a head to head PvP Brawl with up to 4 players!  You can also play co-op or PvP through steam connect, so it's even easier to have fun with your friends.

Major Features


   New World Pythus: A brand new misty world with 40 waves of new enemies to face
   New Weapons and Avatars: Own enemies with the new laser mechanics and brand new avatars
   PvP Brawl: See who's really the best in a head to head brawl with up to 4 players
   Steam Connect: Easily join your friends in multiplayer co-op and PvP directly through steam
   Moving Obstacles: Use these new mechanics to best your foes
   Customizable Keybindings: Change your action keys to own your enemies however you please
   Balancing Changes: Own equally with many different builds


Minor Changes


   Avatar Icons have been revamped
   New item rarities have been added
   Clearer item descriptions have been added
   Partial rewards are given for partially completing maps
   Teleport is now instant
   Aegis now prevents being stunned


Bug Fixes


   Stat Screen is no longer blurry
   Avatars now show the correct weapon types
   Fixed issue causing grapple not to work in certain scenarios
   Fixed issue causing teleport not to work in certain scenarios
   Cooldown timers now work properly with cooldown altering effects
   Fixed rounding issues on Stat text
   Made it visually easier to see certain effects
   Repeated audio on multi-kills and other achievements no longer stack indefinitely

notes.title: Release for Mac OS X and Roadmap
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Armored Evolution has arrived for Mac OS X!  Those with apple computers will now be able to join in on the fun!  Multiplayer should work between Mac and Windows computers as well.

Please note that there was a brief period where downloading the mac version did not download any files.  The issue has been fixed, so please try again.

We've also received a lot of good feedback from our player base.  We've heard you and we're busy incorporating your feedback.  The next release should include PvP, a new Planet, difficulty levels, and a number of bug fixes!  Then onward to include more content and features :)

Roadmap

Version 1.0.1 (Should release in a couple weeks)


   Brawl Mode: Fight against your friends in a fast paced PvP arena.  Choose from any of the PvE maps!
   New Planet: A whole new planet with new enemies to annihilate
   New Weapons: Use these weapons to bring out a whole new way to play
   Difficulty Levels: You've beat the game on Normal, but how about on Legendary
   Key Bindings: Change your direction and action keys to fit your playstyle
   Teleport: Fixed a bug causing teleport to work unreliably
   Score Screen: Fixed a bug causing blurriness


 Future Versions  (Should release in a month or 2)


   Steam Connect: Play multiplayer with your steam friends easily
   Random Modifiers: Get loot with special modifiers that give you that needed edge
   Timers and Leaderboards: Let's see who really beats the level the fastest
   Achievements: Show off just how good of a player you are
